name: jobnimbus-operator
description: Thresher-locked Mac operator for the exact 58 Chance JobNimbus files, with approved notes, JobNimbus/Gmail actions and single-file Retell claim filing.

interface.shortDescription: Work the 58 Chance files and open claims with exact approvals.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to an immutable 58-file Chance roster through an exact provider-attested bridge build and six-receipt historical-isolation attestation. JobNimbus writes and Gmail draft creation stay in the existing approval batch; one reviewed bridge-created draft may be sent only through a later sole-operation plan and separate exact approval with Gmail Sent readback. The activated notes release adds one exact approved note with provider ID and text-hash readback, optionally binding one canonical @RichardR mention request without claiming notification delivery. A separate single-file Retell lane can file a new claim or find an existing claim only after fresh evidence, live agent-configuration verification, complete plan display, and exact Chance approval. #2628, automatic writeback, raw sends, direct notes, task completion, calendar writes, generic/homeowner/follow-up calls, company mutations, and backward stage moves remain blocked.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run bridge_restart_verify first and require the exact provider-attested build, Mac identity, six-receipt historical-isolation attestation, pinned JobNimbus action-batch plus single-file Retell claim-filing boundary, 58-file manifest, ready:true, unresolvedCount:0, and hardBlockedCount:0. Reconcile only explicitly eligible new unresolved receipts; historical attention is never replayed and hard-blocked receipts stop work. For claim filing, verify the live Retell configuration, prepare only one exact manifest file with includeCarrierBatch:false and goal file_new_claim or find_existing_claim, show the complete plan/destination/digest/approval ID, and call only after exact current approval. Never touch #2628, expose claim writeback, or use raw/direct sends. A reviewed bridge-created Gmail draft may be sent only through a later sole-operation gmail.send_existing_draft plan and separate exact current approval.
